summary: Concurrent conviction under Section 420 IPC and Section 12(2) Passports Act; principle of parity applied after identical evidence against co-accused; conviction reversed due to lack of direct evidence linking appellant to fraudulent passport issuance; hostile witness PW-3 testimony unreliable; handwriting expert PW-16 inconclusive; no documentary proof of payment or appellant's knowledge of prior passport; acquittal of accused 3 and 4 inconsistent with appellant's conviction; appeal allowed with dismissal of conviction.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside due to benefit of principle of parity and insufficient evidence against appellant.
